descricao_efeito: A castle given as a prize for winning the contest, a town with a population of 10,000 included. Its residents will live according to whatever laws and commands you issue.

nome: Patch of Forest (Area of Dense Forest)
descricao_efeito: The entrance to the giant forest called the "Mountain God's Garden," where many unique endemic species live. They are all tame and friendly.
arquivo_imagem: 001 - Patch of Forest (Area of Dense Forest).png

nome: Plot of Beach (Area of the Coastline)
descricao_efeito: The entrance to a cave called "Poseidon's Cavern." The cave changes its path at each visit, confusing intruders.
arquivo_imagem: 002 - Plot of Beach (Area of the Coastline).png

nome: Pitcher of Eternal Water (Spring Water Jar)
descricao_efeito: A jar from which pure, clean water (1440 L per day) continually flows.
arquivo_imagem: 003 - Pitcher of Eternal Water (Spring Water Jar).png

nome: Skin Care Hot Springs (Beautiful-Skin Hot Spring)
descricao_efeito: A hot spring that cures you of any skin condition. Bathing in it for half an hour daily gives you skin as soft and smooth as a baby's.
arquivo_imagem: 004 - Skin Care Hot Springs (Beautiful-Skin Hot Spring).png

nome: Spirited Away Hollow (Cave of the Disappearance by Spirits)
descricao_efeito: Enter and then exit this hollow, and you will be transported to a desolate location within the country. Circumstances will allow you to return to where you started without spending any money.
arquivo_imagem: 005 - Spirited Away Hollow (Cave of the Disappearance by Spirits).png

descricao_efeito: Draw some of this spring's water; one hour later, it will become a random alcoholic drink of exquisite taste and extraordinary quality.
Carry a stone (weighing 7 lb. each) for one month, and you will get pregnant, even if you're male. You may choose the sex of the baby by the female or male stone.
Release one fish into this pond, and there will be one more fish of that type the next day. You can keep any combination of fish in this pond, even saltwater, and freshwater fish together!

nome: Tree of Plenty (Tree of Bountiful Harvest)
descricao_efeito: A tree that bears all sorts of fruit. No matter how much you harvest, it will be full again the next day. The type and number of fruit are random.
arquivo_imagem: 009 - Tree of Plenty (Tree of Bountiful Harvest).png

descricao_efeito: A travel guide that lists where and when you can meet people of the opposite sex who are your type.
When faced with a two-option choice, these scales will tell you which is better for your future.
Each day you will find a word glowing gold. You should learn those words because they will come in handy the next day.
Refrain from using the little things of good luck in your daily life; you can accumulate and convert them into cash.
Cut a picture of someone you don't want to see with these scissors, and you will never see them again. Caution: It will affect everyone in the picture (except yourself).

This genie will grant you three wishes, but you need to suggest 1000 potential, significantly different wishes and he will choose three from among them. (No cheating by asking for different increments of money.)

nome: Fairy King's Advice (Advice of the Fairy King)
descricao_efeito: The Fairy King offers you gently, apt advice on what you lack or what you should fix. The annoying thing is he appears when he wants to.
arquivo_imagem: 016 - Fairy King's Advice (Advice of the Fairy King).png

descricao_efeito: She cures one person of all wounds and ills, restoring them to perfect health. She will only appear once.
You will experience the most amazing ecstasy when she winks at you. She can appear multiple times. Be warned, it can get addictive.
Sleep on this pillow, and your astral form will be able to wander at will, but you will turn into a real ghost if you do not return to your body within 24 hours.
This clock sets your current state of mind. Turn it to noon, and you will maintain perfect serenity. Thus you can adjust your emotions according to the situation.
You can see through things. An adjustment dial allows you to set the x-ray depth. The only thing it cannot see through is a pack of spell cards from Masadora.
A beast on the verge of extinction has a habit of stuffing things in its 4-D pocket. You never know what kind of treasures it could have picked up.

nome: Tome of a Thousand Tales (Ad-lib Book)
descricao_efeito: A book that shows you a different story each time you open it. Use the special included bookmark if you want to stay on the same story when you put it down.
arquivo_imagem: 023 - Tome of a Thousand Tales (Ad-lib Book).png

descricao_efeito: Input a hypothetical situation with the included remote, and this TV will show you a 30-hour documentary of the possibilities. You are also able to record.
A twenty-sided die with one skull face and 19-star faces. When you roll a star, great things happen, but rolling the skull will be bad enough to cancel out all the previous great events.
They can do any work you can, and they will work as long as you are asleep. They cannot do anything beyond your abilities.

nome: Book of V.I.P Passes (Face Recognition Multi-Use Pass)
descricao_efeito: You can go anywhere with these passes. Book of 1000.
arquivo_imagem: 027 - Book of V.I.P Passes (Face Recognition Multi-Use Pass).png

descricao_efeito: A remote control to manipulate ten emotions someone feels toward someone else, on an intensity scale of 1-10. (You cannot control how people feel toward you.)
Write the name of any commercially available product on a voucher, and you'll be guaranteed to get it regardless of its scarcity (You still have to pay). A book of 1000.
Seat someone on this cushion, and he will do one thing for you, so long as it is within his capabilities.

nome: Double Postcard to the Dead (Return Postcard to the Dead)
descricao_efeito: Address and mail this return postage-paid postcard to a deceased person, and you will get a reply the next day. A book of 1000.
arquivo_imagem: 031 - Double Postcard to the Dead (Return Postcard to the Dead).png

descricao_efeito: Sucking on this candy enables you to produce any voice. The effect lasts until you next ingest something. A set of 10 packs, 50 candies per pack.
After eating this candy, your sex will temporarily change for 24 hours. A set of 10 boxes; 20 cookies per box.
Write various questions about yourself and give them to someone, and he will answer all questions honestly. Reusable.
An endangered species. Once tamed, it can transform into any animal. However, its mass remains constant, so it will be a tiny elephant or a large hamster, for example.
Put something broken in this room, and it will be repaired as good as new 24 hours later. The door must not be opened until the time is up.

nome: Fledgling Athlete (Egg of Top-Class Sports Athlete)
descricao_efeito: Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top athlete when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
arquivo_imagem: 037 - Fledgling Athlete (Egg of Top-Class Sports Athlete).png

descricao_efeito: Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top artist when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.

Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top politician when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top musician when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top pilot when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top novelist when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top gambler when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top actor when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.

nome: Fledgling CEO (Egg of Great Company President)
descricao_efeito: Warm this magic egg in your hand for three hours a day for one to ten years, and you will become a top CEO when it hatches. The stronger your desire during incubation, the sooner it will hatch.
arquivo_imagem: 045 - Fledgling CEO (Egg of Great Company President).png

descricao_efeito: A girl who sheds gold dust from her body—500g of gold can be harvested from her daily bath. Very shy, she rarely leaves the house.
A girl who sleeps in your stead. You can be active for 24 hours without sleeping while she sleeps for you.
A girl who emits the most comfortable aroma for you. While she's by your side, you will be free of stress.
A mermaid small enough to fit in your hand. A comfortable living environment puts her in a good mood, and she will sing with her beautiful voice.
A dinosaur small enough to fit in your hand. This creature produces a different species of tiny dinosaur with each new generation.
A dragon small enough to fit in your hand. It will obey your commands and eventually learn to talk if raised with love.
Each of these locusts has a pearl in its abdomen. An outbreak occurs once every dozen years or so.

nome: King White Stag Beetle (White King Dorcus)
descricao_efeito: It uses special pheromones to lure other insects to build a huge colony. It leaves the colony once a day for an evening stroll.
arquivo_imagem: 053 - King White Stag Beetle (White King Dorcus).png

descricao_efeito: A legendary insect named after the fact that the family of anyone who captures it will prosper for generations.
Report your grudges to the manager, and he will retaliate for you in proportion to your grievance. Pay extra to request a more severe retaliation.
Specify a time and date to get a picture of yourself in the past. You may also request a sequence of photographs.
The agent will build a secret room just for you at your chosen place. However, you must not tell anyone about it or bring anybody to it.

nome: Secrets Video Rental (Secret Video Rental Store)
descricao_efeito: Rent videos of other peoples secrets. You must not show the video or discuss its contents with anyone.
arquivo_imagem: 058 - Secrets Video Rental (Secret Video Rental Store).png

nome: Instant Foreign Language School (Instant Foreign Language School)
descricao_efeito: Spend time studying a language at this school, and you will accrue time on a timer (included). While the timer is activated and counting down, you will be fluent.
arquivo_imagem: 059 - Instant Foreign Language School (Instant Foreign Language School).png

nome: Long Lost Delivery (Lost Items Delivery Service)
descricao_efeito: Call the number and describe the item you lost, which will be delivered to you the next day. It must be lost for longer than a month.
arquivo_imagem: 060 - Long Lost Delivery (Lost Items Delivery Service).png

descricao_efeito: A full-body medical scan for just 500. However, the only results are "All Clear" or "Anomaly Detected," in which case it is recommended you see a doctor.
Everyone in the club will do your bidding while you are there. However, one hour in the club equals a day outside.
You can order any food you want. You will feel full, but it is only an illusion. You will be given a multivitamin as you leave.

nome: Witch's Love Potion (Aphrodisiac of the Witch)
descricao_efeito: Kiss a pill and have your intended drink it, and he or she will fall in love with you. One pill lasts one week; one vial contains 500 pills.
arquivo_imagem: 064 - Witch's Love Potion (Aphrodisiac of the Witch).png

nome: Witch's Rejuvenation Potion (Youth-Restoring Potion of the Witch)
descricao_efeito: Each pill makes you physically younger by one year. You will retain all knowledge and memories. Beware, as you will die if you take more than your age. One vial contains 100 pills.
arquivo_imagem: 065 - Witch's Rejuvenation Potion (Youth-Restoring Potion of the Witch).png

nome: Witch's Diet Pills (Weight-Loss Medicine of the Witch)
descricao_efeito: Each pill makes you lose one kg. One vial contains 200 pills. Beware, as you will die if you take more than you weigh.
arquivo_imagem: 066 - Witch's Diet Pills (Weight-Loss Medicine of the Witch).png

nome: Doyen's Growth Pills (Stretching Medicine of the Elder)
descricao_efeito: Each pill makes you grow one cm taller. One vial contains 100 pills. Not recommended for people under 20 years of age.
arquivo_imagem: 067 - Doyen's Growth Pills (Stretching Medicine of the Elder).png

nome: Doyen's Virility Pills (Virility-Enhancing Medicine of the Elder)
descricao_efeito: A certain part of your anatomy will get very frisky. Both endurance and frequency are enhanced. One vial contains 500 pills.
arquivo_imagem: 068 - Doyen's Virility Pills (Virility-Enhancing Medicine of the Elder).png

nome: Doyen's Hair Restorer (Hair Growth Medicine of the Elder)
descricao_efeito: Luxurious hair will grow wherever it is applied. Use gloves or hair will grow on fingers and palms. One vial contains 200 ml (enough to cover ten heads).
arquivo_imagem: 069 - Doyen's Hair Restorer (Hair Growth Medicine of the Elder).png

nome: Mad Scientist's Steroids (Muscle-Enhancing Drug of the Mad Scientist)
descricao_efeito: Get all the muscles you want without exercise. You must drink a liter a day for a week, and it tastes horrible. A seven-box set, with ten one-L bottles per box.
arquivo_imagem: 070 - Mad Scientist's Steroids (Muscle-Enhancing Drug of the Mad Scientist).png

nome: Mad Scientist's Pheromones (Pheromone Drug of the Mad Scientist)
descricao_efeito: Spray on your body to attract the opposite sex. However, you cannot adjust the strength of its effect, so be careful as it may cause a proliferation of stalkers.
arquivo_imagem: 071 - Mad Scientist's Pheromones (Pheromone Drug of the Mad Scientist).png

nome: Mad Scientist's Plastic Surgery (Plastic Surgery Machine of the Mad Scientist)
descricao_efeito: Scan a picture of the face you want, and you will have an exact likeness. Each surgery carries a 5% chance of failure, and a 1% chance the machine itself will break.
arquivo_imagem: 072 - Mad Scientist's Plastic Surgery (Plastic Surgery Machine of the Mad Scientist).png

descricao_efeito: A jewel "blessed" by the Devil. When danger is about to befall its owner, it will deflect it to someone else.
Its owner will have many intelligent friends and keep those friendships for their entire lives.

nome: Wild Luck Alexandrite (Alexandrite of Strange Fortune)
descricao_efeito: Its owner will get to have once-in-a-lifetime experiences, though you cannot choose whether they're for better or for worse...
arquivo_imagem: 075 - Wild Luck Alexandrite (Alexandrite of Strange Fortune).png

descricao_efeito: The owner of this ruby will gain immense wealth, but will never be able to remain in the same place for more than a week.

nome: Beauty Magnet Emerald (Emerald That Calls Beauty)
descricao_efeito: Specialists offering beauty services flock to its owner, who will shine with unrecognized beauty.
arquivo_imagem: 077 - Beauty Magnet Emerald (Emerald That Calls Beauty).png

descricao_efeito: The owner of this sapphire will acquire vast wealth, but in exchange, will spend a lifetime alone, forsaken by friends, family, and significant others.
A diamond that shines in a rainbow of colors. Propose with this diamond, and she is guaranteed to say "yes."
A stone about one carat in size that levitates. It can levitate one person, and receives energy from sunlight.
A unique blue jewel. Its composition does not correspond to any known mineral, so it was given this name to mean "a gift from space."

nome: Staff of Judgment (Staff of Divine Punishment)
descricao_efeito: Raise this staff in the air while calling out the name of someone you want to punish, and calamity will befall the one of you who has committed more bad deeds, the target or yourself.
arquivo_imagem: 082 - Staff of Judgment (Staff of Divine Punishment).png

descricao_efeito: Splits in two anything and anyone deceitful. In trials, it's a criminal's worst nightmare. The sword will shatter when used to cut something true, but will regenerate if stored in its scabbard for one day.

nome: Paladin's Necklace (Necklace of the Holy Knight)
descricao_efeito: A player wearing this will reflect curses cast upon him, and be able to undo curses placed on cards he touches.
arquivo_imagem: 084 - Paladin's Necklace (Necklace of the Holy Knight).png

descricao_efeito: Renders ineffective any attack by a weapon reverted from a card. Beware, as it will randomly break sometime within the first 100 attacks.
You can cast as many "Leaves" as you have arrows. It comes with 10 arrows, and one will be used each time you cast "Leave."
The spells "Relegate," "Return," "Drift," and "Collision" will be rendered ineffective within a radius of 20 M of the player armed with this shield.

Anyone hit with this hammer will be afflicted with one random attack spell, and cannot defend him or herself with a defensive spell. However, it will not work on someone using "Fortress" or Paladin's Necklace.

nome: Tax Collector's Gauntlet (Gauntlet of the Head of Tax Affairs)
descricao_efeito: Grants you the ability to cast "Levy." However, it will destroy one random specified slot card from your binder every time. (You cannot cast it if your specified slots are empty.)
arquivo_imagem: 089 - Tax Collector's Gauntlet (Gauntlet of the Head of Tax Affairs).png

descricao_efeito: You will never forget things you see or hear while wearing this helmet. Unfortunately, it's extremely large and heavy.
Recombine the parts of this 1:1 scale model kit to build any kind of vehicle. Fully functional, fuel not included.
Rip the ticket and give it to someone you want to switch with, and you can live his life for 24 hours. Book of 1000.
An encyclopedia of everyone who's been in your life since your birth, with records of conversations and memorable incidents. It may end up being tens of thousands of pages long.
A successful attack with this weapon will cast "Mug", "Pickpocket", or "Thief" on the target. Not effective on someone using "Fortress" or "Paladin's Necklace".
You will be under the effect of "Blackout Curtain" while wearing this cape.

nome: Clairvoyant Snake (Snake of the All-Seeing Eye)
descricao_efeito: Feed it a card Rank C or above, and it will spit up a "Clairvoyance."
arquivo_imagem: 096 - Clairvoyant Snake (Snake of the All-Seeing Eye).png

descricao_efeito: Pictures taken with this will be developed as 3-D objects, with all textures reproduced. Make enlargements as needed.
An endangered species with silver fur. Mix 5g of gold into its food daily, and it will excrete one kg of solid silver feces.
An endangered species. Very neat and loves to cook, each has a hobby such as sewing or gardening. They are excellent at taking care of human children.
A map of the island. No towns or markers are currently shown. The user will automatically fill these in on their travels.
A detailed map of the island, with all towns and markers already shown.
A special voucher which transforms into the card Angel's Breath once one becomes available.
A letter which extends a warm invitation to visit the game's capital city, Limeiro. A visit to this city's castle is also included.
These villagers are very sick.
These villagers are as healthy as can be!
A ticket that allows the bearer to use a safe passage out of the game.
These one-eyed giants are the largest of all Cyclops. They travel in small groups and attack anything within their territory.
This hard-to-catch creature emits bubbles when threatened as a diversionary tactic. White bubbles will burst in contact with Aura. Red ones will burst with everything else except Aura.
The leader of a wolf pack that attacks travelers.
10,000 in card form.
This little creature is a fast fellow. They are a really fast, hard-to-catch species.
A very large lizard big enough to eat a cow whole.

These hard-to-catch creatures use aura to control a suit of armor. As a defensive measure, it uses this armor to mislead a target into thinking the armor is the enemy whilst the true creature can escape.
This fish when cooked, tastes delicious.
A fish. Debut in Chapter 172.
The guard is an NPC. He guarded the Gold Dust Girl.
A vial containing gasoline. This flammable substance will catch fire easily.
A simple rock. Quite hard and can be any size.
A large rock.
View contents of target player's (previously met) free slots.
View contents of target player's (previously met) designated slots.
Protects you from an attack spell once.
Reflects an attack spell from a player (previously met).
Allows one person to fly to the location of the target player.
Steals a random card from target player's free pocket.
Steals a random card from target player's designated pocket.
Swaps a card the caster's owns to a target player's card randomly.
Allows caster to fly back to a previously visited location.
Transform a card into a copy of a target card that the caster already owns (if the card limit was at MAX, the transformation fails and "Mimic" disappears).
Change into one random card from target player's imposed slots (if the opponent has no imposed slot cards or the card limit was at MAX, the transformation fails and "Clone" disappears).
Make the target player fly somewhere on the island.
Make target player fly to the game starting point.
Make target player leave the island.
See all card data of the target player.
Go to a random unvisited town. If all towns have been visited, player stays at the same place and the card disappears.
Fly to the locations of a random player the caster has not met (if all other players have been met, players stay at the same place and the card disappears).
Take one random card from each player within a 20m radius.
Protect once against a short range regular spell from another player.

"Fake" transforms into one of the cards from No.001 to No.099. The resulting card can be inserted into an imposed slot but does not count towards a complete card set or the card copy limit, nor can it be converted into an object.
Take one card at will from target player.

Transform one above-B ranked card from target player into a below-D card. The caster can choose the number of the new card. (After the transformation, the card counts towards the card number limit of the new card type. If the limit is already at MAX, or the target player has no above-B cards, the transformation fails and the “Corruption” card disappears). After the transformation, if the card is in an imposed slot with a wrong number, it is automatically destroyed.

Choose and destroy one above-A ranked card from target player. That player then obtains a card of 3 ranks lower than the destroyed card and of the number of his choosing. If target player has no above-A card, “Compromise” changes into card form again and returns to the caster. (If the designated card of three ranks lower has attained the card copy limit, it cannot be obtained.)

Return all cards from target player transformed with “Fake,” “Clone,” or “Mimic” to their original form. Destroy all cards that, as a result, find themselves in the wrong imposed slots. “Fake,” “Copy,” and “Mimic” have no effect on “Dispel.”
Use to protect oneself against the effects of "Peek" and "Fluoroscopy".
Protects the player ten times from attack spells from other players. This card is immune to steal and destruction spells.
Current location of one target player will be available at all times. (Effect lasts until player leaves the game.)
Destroy one random card in target player's free slots.
Destroy one random card in target player's imposed slots.
Give away locations of the chosen number (not available to No. 000).
Show explanation on card of the chosen number (not available to No. 000).
Transform into a random item card.
Complete data of one player's restricted slots will be available at all times. (Effect lasts until player leaves the game.)

Dispel effect of transformation spell and return the card to original form. (If, after transformation, the card limit is exceeded, the card changes to item form and cannot be converted again. In the case of a spell card, it disappears unless the spell is used immediately.)
Cards inserted in slots on target Imposed Slot page are permanently protected against stealing and destruction spells as long as they remain in the slots (Free Slot pages cannot be chosen).
Caster permanently obtains the effects of "List" and "Analysis" on all cards from No. 000 to 099. (Effect lasts until target player leaves the game.)

Allows an item converted from a card to be changed into card form once more. (Limited to cards of rank below C. If the applicable card limit is already at MAX, “Recycle” disappears without converting the target item.)
Reveals the number of people in possession of the target card as well as the total number of copies.

Fly the caster and all players within a 20-meter radius of the caster to the location of the target city (limited to cities previously visited) or target player (limited to players previously met inside the game).

Allows communication through the binders with target player (limited to players previously met inside the game. Maximum duration is 3 minutes; during this period, only the player initiating conversation with “Contact” can cut off communication.)
Allows the caster to forcibly activate any special in-game event.
Allows the caster to stop an NPC or enemy from taking any further actions.
Allows the caster to reset all the card data of one target player.
Allows the caster to transport any elements that illegally enter Greed Island to a random location on the Azian Continent.
